armyRules.name: Waaagh!
armyRules.effect: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can re-roll Advance rolls and become 'riled up' as stated in other rules. While riled up: unit has 5+ invulnerable save, ranged attacks gain [ASSAULT], and Advance moves do not prevent charge eligibility. War Cry (once per battle, per army): at the start of the Command phase, make all ORKS units with this ability riled up until the end of the next turn.

armyRules.name: Da Boss
armyRules.effect: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your Warlord, gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Unstable Energies
armyRules.effect: ORKS PSYKER units have a psyker level; in a battle round they can use psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed their psyker level.
